words.example_en: Throw away the rotten apple so it doesn't spoil the rest.
words.example_uz: Qolganlarini buzmasligi uchun chirigan olmani tashlab yuboring.

words.example_en: We used the stale bread to make crunchy croutons.
words.example_uz: Biz qotgan nondan qarsildoq suxariklar tayyorlashda foydalandik.

words.example_en: The milk smelled sour because it was spoiled.
words.example_uz: Sut aynib qolgani uchun undan nordon hid kelardi.

words.example_en: Never eat raw chicken or undercooked meat.
words.example_uz: Hech qachon xom tovuq yoki chala pishgan goʻsht yemang.

words.example_en: These organic apples were grown without pesticides.
words.example_uz: Bu organik olmalar pestitsidlarsiz yetishtirilgan.

words.example_en: The ripe peach was so juicy that it dripped down my chin.
words.example_uz: Pishgan shaftoli shunchalik sersuv ediki, iyagimdan oqib tushdi.

words.example_en: Seedless green grapes are dried to make golden raisins.
words.example_uz: Danaksiz kishmish uzumlari oltinrang mayiz tayyorlash uchun quritiladi.

words.example_en: Make sure the wild mushrooms are edible before picking them.

words.example_en: Walnuts and honey make a very nutritious snack.
words.example_uz: Yongʻoq va asal juda toʻyimli yegulik boʻladi.

words.example_en: Smooth-skinned nectarines are sweet and fragrant in summer.
words.example_uz: Silliq poʻstli nektarinlar yozda shirin va xushboʻy boʻladi.

words.example_en: Wild red medlar berries grow in the Chimgan mountains.
words.example_uz: Chimyon togʻlarida yovvoyi qizil doʻlana mevalari oʻsadi.

words.example_en: Dried jujube fruits are prized in traditional Eastern medicine.
words.example_uz: Quritilgan chilonjiyda mevalari Sharq tabobatida qadrlanadi.
